newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra cites trade blowout in deficit hike.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra cites trade blowout in deficit hike.

text.p: Australia's Acting Treasurer John Fahey said on Monday the higher-than-expected current account deficit for November was the result of a A$389 million increase in the merchandise trade deficit.
Fahey said in a statement the deterioration in the merchandise trade balance was due to a 4.9 percent fall in exports and a 1.2 percent rise in imports.

Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.923 billion in November from October's deficit of A$1.807 billion (revised from A$1.788 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Economists had on average forecast a seasonally adjusted November current account deficit of about A$1.75 billion.
